labels.name: Flexor retinaculum
labels.function: Roof of the median tunnel; divided in its release surgery

labels.name: Median nerve
labels.function: Thumb, index, middle, radial ring sensation; thumb opposition

labels.name: Palmar cutaneous branch of the median nerve
labels.function: Exits proximal to the tunnel, so thenar and central palm skin is spared

labels.name: Ulnar nerve
labels.function: Compressed in its wrist canal by handlebars; grip and pinch weakness

labels.name: Palmar carpal ligament
labels.function: Roof of Guyon canal; divided in Guyon canal release

labels.name: Hook of the hamate
labels.function: Medial tunnel pillar; lateral wall of Guyon canal

labels.name: Pisiform
labels.function: Medial-most wall of Guyon canal; medial carpal tunnel border

labels.name: Tubercle of the scaphoid
labels.function: Lateral (radial) tunnel attachment in the proximal carpal row

labels.name: Ridge of the trapezium
labels.function: Lateral (radial) tunnel attachment in the distal carpal row

labels.name: Median nerve
labels.function: Thumb-to-radial-ring sensation; thumb abduction and opposition

labels.name: Carpal tunnel
labels.function: Most common entrapment site; probed by Tinel and Phalen tests

labels.name: Palmar cutaneous branch of the median nerve
labels.function: Runs superficial to the retinaculum; thenar skin stays normal

labels.name: Thenar muscles
labels.function: Atrophy here implies chronic or severe median compression

labels.name: Ulnar nerve
labels.function: Supplies little-finger skin; controls finger abduction/adduction

labels.name: Medial epicondyle
labels.function: Bony landmark the nerve passes behind at the elbow

labels.name: Cubital tunnel
labels.function: Elbow flexion raises its pressure; 2nd most common entrapment

labels.name: Guyon canal
labels.function: 4-cm wrist canal between pisiform and hamate; cycling compresses it

labels.name: Dorsal cutaneous branch of the ulnar nerve
accept: dorsal branch of the ulnar nerve
labels.function: Leaves above the wrist; its back-of-hand area is spared at the wrist
